name: zcode-breaker
description: Tool circuit breaker for ZCode: blocks the same (tool + input) repeated over the limit within a window, and warns on repeated prompts. Same rule as unified-rx-mcp tools/breaker.py.

description_i18n.en: Tool circuit breaker for ZCode: blocks the same (tool + input) repeated over the limit within a window, and warns on repeated prompts.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 工具熔断：同一（工具+参数）在窗口内重复超过阈值即阻断，重复指令告警。与 unified-rx-mcp 的 tools/breaker.py 同规则（宿主级 + 工具级双保险）。
